active.instruction: Use the measured planning feedback to propose two distinct bounded search programs that reduce setup costs on new workloads. Consider the choice and ordering of search operations, exploration and acceptance. Explain each hypothesis briefly.

configuration.instruction:
Design exactly two NEW scheduling search programs under the unchanged program contract and 256-evaluation budget. Optimize mean cost reduction of the system actually retained by the full libRSI process, not the best proposal. Target a gain of at least 0.005 in retained reduction on new draws; do not claim this has been demonstrated.

Treat feedback as noisy evidence. The eight retained results average about 16.13%; seven retained programs contain annealing and one uses pure descent. There are no individual scores for unretained proposals or controlled comparisons across runs. Neither proposal order nor the highest run identifies a superior design. The repeated expensive-descent/anneal/polish template has been explored much more than its alternatives.

For this call, investigate whether exploration consumes evaluations better spent on complementary descent. Make BOTH proposals credible adoption candidates: one exploitation-focused program with no uphill acceptance; one related program with only 24–40 evaluations of cooling exploration at temperature 0.003–0.012. Allocate the remaining evaluations to useful descent, including substantial final refinement. Preserve a common strong backbone where practical so feedback tests a meaningful mechanism rather than many simultaneous changes.

Construct that backbone deliberately. Combine costly-transition targeting with unbiased random sampling or a dedicated single-operator scan. Favor relocation and swap, but do not treat reversal as mathematically useless in an asymmetric problem. Separate operators when this improves coverage rather than automatically alternating them. There are 78 unordered position pairs, but a changing incumbent means a scan is not certification of local optimality; relocation direction and scan cursor behavior must not be invented. Mixed-operator scans do not necessarily scan each operator's neighborhood.

Temperature is a fraction of the entire starting cycle cost: 0.03 is about 0.42 times its mean arc cost, not automatically a small perturbation. After exploratory acceptance, restart from best for final descent. Best-so-far protection prevents regression within a run but does not recover wasted evaluations.

Privately audit stage allocations, rounding, operator order, restart semantics and all schema limits. Use 1–6 stages and integer weights 1–100. Return exactly two distinct configurations {"program":"JSON TEXT"} with short hypothesis reasons identifying the changed mechanism and its risk. No tools, extra evaluations, workload-specific rules, invented feedback or changes to native gates.

choices.reason: Hypothesis: replacing long, relatively warm exploration with complementary descent or brief cooler exploration improves retained performance while making proposal comparisons more informative.

configuration.instruction:
Propose exactly two distinct NEW bounded scheduling programs, each obeying the unchanged contract and using only 256 cost evaluations. The objective is mean reduction of the system actually adopted after all libRSI gates, including outcomes where an incumbent is retained—not oracle selection of the best proposed candidate. Seek at least +0.5 percentage points over the eight-run retained mean of approximately 16.13%; this is an unverified target.

Diagnose feedback before designing. Most adopted programs repeat one long descent/exploration/polish trajectory. Seven use annealing; this supports keeping annealing plausible, not claiming its causal superiority. The records provide neither candidate-level scores nor paired workload comparisons, so do not rank mechanisms by different runs' retained reductions. Use any subsequently supplied feedback only at its demonstrated level, distinguishing proposal, verification and actual retention.

Test a different search architecture: two bounded attempts anchored to the best cycle, with repair after diversification. Candidate A should use a compact kick-and-repair architecture: establish a useful incumbent, restart from best with one random-swap kick, then devote substantially more evaluations to repair than to perturbation. Candidate B should instead use a brief low-temperature annealed excursion from best followed by repair, without a kick. These must be serious competing designs, not a strong candidate paired with a token novelty. Generate their exact stages afresh; do not select from a fixed inventory.

Use at most six stages. Reserve at least 64 evaluations for the final descent from best; keep the total exploratory stage allocation at most 48 evaluations. A kick stage uses its first evaluation to score the perturbed cycle; its remaining evaluations should usually repair it with improve acceptance. Restore best before the final polish. Consider a different operator or sampler for repair versus initial descent so the second attempt does not merely revisit the same search path. Favor relocation and swap for directed costs, with expensive sampling balanced by random or single-operator scan coverage. Do not assume scan resets, relocation direction or adaptive stopping absent from the contract.

For each program, reason privately through incumbent creation, escape, repair and final refinement. Justify every stage's opportunity cost; best-so-far protection does not make exploration free. Check temperature against whole-cycle cost, exact weight-derived allocations, kick accounting and JSON validity. Do not fabricate candidate performance, change distributions or gates, add primitives or spend evaluations outside the budget. Return exactly two {"program":"JSON TEXT"} configurations with brief reasons stating a mechanism and failure risk, not promised gains.

choices.reason: Hypothesis: a small, explicitly repaired basin change offers more productive diversification than prolonged annealing, while two credible alternatives reduce dependence on a single search architecture.

primary_contrast.method: 10000 crossed bootstrap draws: independent model draws by arm; shared workload draws stratified by four families
